skill.summary: 全能电商运营全链路闭环技能，覆盖平台规则合规、免费/付费流量运营、商品与供应链管理、转化优化、内容电商与直播、数据化运营与复盘、营销大促操盘、私域全域运营、团队管理、风险管控。全能电商运营核心能力清单。当用户提到电商运营、流量运营、直播运营、供应链管理、私域运营、数据复盘、营销大促、团队管理等时激活。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of omni-channel-ecommerce-master v1.0.0

- Covers end-to-end e-commerce operations: compliance, free/paid traffic, product/supply chain, conversion optimization, content e-commerce, data operations, big campaign management, private traffic, team/organization, and risk control.
- Provides a comprehensive capability checklist for omni-channel e-commerce operation, supporting activation via keywords such as traffic ops, livestreaming, supply chain, marketing, and team management.
- Includes detailed guides for platform compliance, all-channel traffic acquisition, supply chain management, conversion and user experience, content and livestream commerce, data-driven operations, marketing campaigns, private domain management, team building, and risk mitigation.
- Designed for maximum coverage across major platforms: Taobao/Tmall, JD.com, Pinduoduo, Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, and more.
- Enables users to invoke the skill for any mainstream e-commerce operation scenario and related operational challenges.
